svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Every 8x8 piece domain, block layout, and asymmetric attack mask fits inside a single 64-bit integer.
Blocks stop sliding rays while knights jump over them, leaving safe squares (green) in one bitwise instruction.
forbidMask (uint64) - attacked by or attacking placed pieces
